# Anime Stickman Blade Fight — Cinematic Scene Script

Style: High-energy anime, black stickman silhouettes, glowing blades, dramatic camera movements, environmental destruction, speed lines, impact frames, and cinematic sound design.

Duration: 60–90 seconds
Setting: An abandoned Japanese temple at night during a thunderstorm.

Characters:
- Shadow: A black stickman wielding a crimson energy katana. Fast, aggressive, unpredictable.
- Phantom: A white stickman wielding two electric-blue blades. Precise, defensive, and incredibly fast.

## Scene 1 — The Encounter (0:00–0:10)

CAMERA: Open with a wide aerial shot of an abandoned temple surrounded by towering trees. Rain falls diagonally across the screen. Lightning illuminates broken rooftops, cracked stone pillars, and scattered cherry blossom petals.

SOUND: Deep thunder. Heavy rain. A faint metallic ringing.

The camera slowly descends toward the temple courtyard.

Shadow stands on a broken stone staircase, his crimson blade pointed toward the ground. Red energy flickers around the sword, illuminating the rain beneath it.

On the opposite rooftop, Phantom appears in a flash of blue lightning.

Phantom draws both blades.

SFX: SHING! SHING!

Shadow tilts his head.

SHADOW: “You came all this way just to lose?”

Phantom lowers his stance.

PHANTOM: “I came to end this.”

A lightning strike splits the sky.

CAMERA: Extreme close-up of both pairs of eyes.

Cut to black for three frames.

## Scene 2 — First Clash (0:10–0:25)

CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot.

Phantom launches forward, his feet cracking the wet stone beneath him. He disappears into a blue streak.

Shadow reacts instantly.

MOVE 1 — LIGHTNING DASH

Phantom appears at Shadow's left side and delivers a diagonal blade slash.

Shadow pivots backward, letting the blue blade pass inches from his chest.

SFX: FWOOSH!

MOVE 2 — CROSS-BLADE COUNTER

Shadow spins and swings his crimson katana horizontally. Phantom crosses both swords to block.

SFX: KRAAANG!

Red and blue sparks explode outward. The shockwave shatters nearby roof tiles.

CAMERA: Orbit around the fighters at the instant their blades collide. Brief slow motion, then a sudden acceleration.

Phantom slides backward across the wet stones.

Shadow charges before Phantom regains balance.

MOVE 3 — THREE-STRIKE COMBINATION
1. A low horizontal slash aimed at the legs.
2. An upward diagonal slash.
3. A spinning overhead strike.

Phantom jumps over the first, deflects the second, and narrowly dodges the third with a backward aerial flip.

The crimson blade crashes into the courtyard, splitting the ground and throwing stone fragments into the air.

SOUND: Music intensifies. Taiko drums enter.

## Scene 3 — Blades of the Storm (0:25–0:45)

CAMERA: Wide shot as both fighters land on opposite ends of the courtyard.

Phantom raises his twin blades. Electric-blue energy travels along their edges, illuminating the rain.

Shadow grips his katana with both hands. Crimson energy begins spiraling around his body.

The rain appears to freeze for one instant.

PHANTOM: “Let's see if you can follow this.”

MOVE 4 — AFTERIMAGE RUSH

Phantom dashes in a zigzag pattern, leaving three blue afterimages. Each image performs a different feint.

Shadow closes his eyes briefly, listening to the footsteps and blade movements.

At the last moment, he turns and blocks the real Phantom's strike.

SFX: CLANG!

Shadow twists his sword, redirects the attack, and pushes Phantom aside.

MOVE 5 — CRIMSON SPIRAL

Shadow performs a full-body spinning slash. A circular wave of red energy expands across the courtyard.

Phantom crosses his swords and braces himself. The wave pushes him through a wooden pillar, which collapses behind him.

CAMERA: Follow Phantom through the debris, then whip-pan back to Shadow as he charges.

Phantom rises and launches both blades upward, forcing Shadow to leap.

Midair, they exchange a rapid sequence of six blade clashes. Every impact creates a brief white flash and a burst of colored sparks.

For one frame, the screen becomes a black silhouette against a white background.

Then the sound returns.

## Scene 4 — Ultimate Techniques (0:45–1:05)

The fighters land on opposite sides of the ruined courtyard.

Their breathing is heavy. Their blades flicker.

CAMERA: Slow push-in toward Shadow's hand tightening around the katana handle.

SHADOW: “Enough.”

He raises his blade toward the storm clouds.

MOVE 6 — CRIMSON MOON: FINAL CUT

A giant crimson arc forms behind Shadow like a burning crescent moon. Red energy gathers around the sword, and the surrounding stones begin to levitate.

Shadow disappears.

The entire courtyard is illuminated red.

Phantom plants both feet, crosses his blades, and draws every remaining spark of electricity into their edges.

PHANTOM: “Not this time.”

MOVE 7 — THUNDER GATE

Phantom launches straight upward in a column of blue lightning. He rotates through the air, crossing his twin blades into an X-shaped energy trail.

The two ultimate attacks collide in midair.

SFX: Complete silence for half a second.

Then—

SFX: DOOOOOOM!

A massive circular shockwave tears through the storm clouds. Roof tiles fly outward. Stone pillars crack. Rain is pushed away from the impact in a perfect ring.

CAMERA: Extreme wide shot from above, showing the red and blue energy spiraling around each other.

The screen flashes white.

## Scene 5 — The Final Frame (1:05–1:15)

Silence.

Smoke drifts through the shattered courtyard. The rain resumes.

Shadow stands motionless, his katana cracked and its crimson glow fading.

Phantom kneels several meters away, one blade embedded in the stone.

A tiny blue spark travels across Phantom's remaining sword.

Shadow turns.

Phantom suddenly rises and makes one final dash.

CAMERA: Extreme slow motion. The two silhouettes pass each other.

A thin red line flashes across the screen.

Both fighters remain still.

One blade falls to the ground.

SFX: TING.

The camera slowly pulls backward as lightning illuminates the temple.

The screen fades to black.

TEXT ON SCREEN: THE BATTLE IS NOT OVER.

END.
